eligibility_rule: Future evidence identity manifest selected by PI-approved non-Strategy custodian after construct freeze under a later preregistration-design Issue; Strategy receives no identities or outcomes before authorized release.
exclusion_rule: Exclude every P1, M6, M6R, M6M, and M6F construct-recovery or discovery evidence item, including all 72 M6R episode IDs and any derivative or overlapping episode.
strategy_visibility_prohibition: Strategy must receive neither reserve identities nor outcomes before a later PI-approved preregistration Issue authorizes release.
